description: This file defines an interface for NativeJS plugin interactions within the WPEFramework, including initialization, application creation/deletion, running scripts, and retrieving applications.

classes.name: INativeJS
classes.description: A virtual interface class exposing methods for managing NativeJS applications within the plugin architecture.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the NativeJS plugin with a Wayland display.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new NativeJS application with given options and outputs its ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs a specified NativeJS application given its ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code in the context of a specified application ID.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves information about existing NativeJS applications.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates a specified NativeJS application by ID.
